name: Document Loader
description: Provides a normalization layer for document loading from various sources.

project_description:
Document Loader provides a consistent, plugin-driven API for ingesting documents from multiple sources and normalizing them into reusable output formats. It standardizes discovery, configuration, and execution of document loaders so other modules can focus on their own features instead of wiring bespoke ingestion logic.

The module ships two plugin types (DocumentLoaderType inputs and DocumentLoader loaders), a dynamic type factory, a FileInput/Output class hierarchy covering ~19 built-in source types (PDF, Word, spreadsheets, images, API endpoints, websites, S3, Notion, GitHub, SharePoint, OneDrive, Slack, and structured formats), and a high-level DocumentLoaderManager service with automatic type detection. It provides the framework only: at least one loader plugin module (e.g. PDF Parser, Webpage) must be installed for actual extraction to occur. Optional submodules add AI Automator types, a Field Widget Actions button, an MDXEditor toolbar button, a media-library opener, and an AI agent Tool integration.
